name: Sendcloud
label: Sendcloud API v3 — shipments, labels, shipping options
description: EU fulfillment via Sendcloud API v3 at https://panel.sendcloud.sc/api/v3. Docs: https://sendcloud.dev/api/v3/shipments/create-and-announce-a-shipment-synchronously. parcel_create requires ship_with, to_address, from_address, parcels. Basic auth public_key:secret_key. Handler: OfficialApiNode. Never log keys or addresses.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One official API operation. Secrets stay in configurationParameters.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Official API v3 verb. EXACT: parcel_create (POST /shipments/announce) | label_create (GET /parcels/{id}/documents/label) | shipping_method_list (POST /shipping-options) | trigger. Blank uses configurationParameters.operation. trigger is ingress (BPMN message event), not an HTTP call.

schema.label: ship_with
schema.description: How to ship. Required on parcel_create. Official: {"type":"shipping_option_code","properties":{"shipping_option_code":"postnl:standard","contract_id":517}}.

schema.label: to_address
schema.description: Recipient address for parcel_create (required) and shipping_method_list. Official Sendcloud address: name, company_name, address_line_1, house_number, city, postal_code, country_code, email, phone_number.

schema.label: from_address
schema.description: Sender address for parcel_create (required) and shipping_method_list. Full address or {"sender_address_id":123}.

schema.label: parcels
schema.description: Parcels array (1–15) for parcel_create (required) and shipping_method_list. Each: weight {value,unit}, optional dimensions and parcel_items.

schema.label: brand_id
schema.description: Brand id for parcel_create. When omitted, brand of from_address.sender_address_id is used.

schema.label: order_number
schema.description: Shop/order number on parcel_create. Example: ORD-1042.

schema.label: external_reference_id
schema.description: Your external shipment id on parcel_create.

schema.label: customs_information
schema.description: Customs block on parcel_create for non-EU: invoice_number, export_reason, invoice_date, goods_description.

schema.label: functionalities
schema.description: shipping_method_list filter, e.g. {"signature":true}. Omit to list activated options.

schema.label: accept
schema.description: label_create Accept header. application/pdf (default) | application/zpl | image/png.

ports.name: output
ports.description: status=ok + data on 2xx. Secrets never present. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Provider HTTP status. Never includes secrets.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body. May contain order PII — do not log values.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: HTTP verb for OfficialApiNode v3. EXACT: parcel_create | label_create | shipping_method_list | trigger. trigger does not open a socket.

configurationParameters.label: Secret Key
configurationParameters.description: StudioQuack secret. Auth type basic. Never log. Customer owns the merchant account.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout Seconds
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout seconds (connect + read). <=0 uses api_spec defaultTimeout.
